test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All papers are books.

Some books are notebooks.

All notebooks are files.

Conclusions:

I. Some papers are notebooks.

II. All books are files.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
From above statement,

All papers**(P)** are books**(B)**.

Some books are notebooks(**N)**.

All notebooks are files**(F)**.

The venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81707e536a35053e01d1e69ef1444f546f8f3f0c27de0e1804cc44a3b6e4f98d.png] 

**Conclusion I: Some papers are notebooks.**(False)

We only know that **all papers are books** and **some books are notebooks**, but it is not necessary that any paper is a notebook.

There is no direct or indirect link confirming that any paper is also a notebook.

**Conclusion II: All books are files.** (False)

**Some books are notebooks**, and **all notebooks are files**.

However, this does not mean that **all books** are files—only some books (those that are notebooks) are files.

**So, the correct answer is Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**
